introduction: This spec defines hub-internal audit event emission from all mutation points, a unified query API merging hub and agent events, a conversation transcript reconstruction endpoint, and a real-time SSE streaming endpoint for the af-hub audit subsystem. Note: requirements referencing apikit, Emitter, HubEvent, and Store APIs are based on PRD descriptions cross-referencing spec 17 (audit_storage_ingestion) and should be verified against installed library signatures before implementation.

glossary.AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS: Environment variable controlling the maximum number of concurrent SSE connections; defaults to 100
glossary.Emitter: The audit.Emitter interface defined in spec 17 (audit_storage_ingestion) used to emit structured audit events to DuckDB
glossary.GET /api/v1/audit: Unified audit event query endpoint returning merged hub and agent events with filtering and cursor pagination
glossary.GET /api/v1/events: SSE streaming endpoint delivering real-time audit events to connected clients
glossary.GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_i: Endpoint that reconstructs a conversation transcript from agent trace data for a specific run and node
glossary.HubEvent: The structured audit event struct defined in spec 17 representing a hub-internal audit event stored in hub_audit_events
glossary.MergeAPIConfig: Configuration struct for the merge API handler package in internal/merge
glossary.RebuildAPIConfig: Configuration struct for the carry-patch rebuild API handler package in internal/carrypatch
glossary.SSE: Server-Sent Events — an HTTP-based protocol for server-to-client real-time event streaming
glossary.Store: The audit.Store interface defined in spec 17 providing DuckDB query access
glossary.UNION ALL: SQL construct used to merge rows from hub_audit_events and agent_audit_events into a single chronological result set
glossary.actor_id: The authenticated user or system identity that performed the audited action, sourced from apikit.GetAuthInfo
glossary.actor_type: The credential type of the actor: admin_token, api_key, pat, or system
glossary.agent_audit_events: DuckDB table storing agent-submitted audit events, defined in spec 17
glossary.agent_traces: DuckDB table storing agent trace/telemetry data used for transcript reconstruction, defined in spec 17
glossary.apikit.FormatUTC: apikit helper function that formats a time value as a UTC ISO 8601 string
glossary.apikit.GetAuthInfo: apikit helper function that extracts authentication information from an Echo context
glossary.apikit.NowUTC: apikit helper function that returns the current time in UTC
glossary.apikit.WriteAPIError: apikit helper function that writes a structured JSON error response to an Echo context
glossary.archetype: Agent archetype field present in agent audit events, null for hub events
glossary.assistant.message: Agent trace event type representing an assistant response, mapped to the assistant role in transcripts
glossary.audit:read: Permission scope defined in spec 17 (internal/audit/permissions.go) required to query audit events
glossary.audit_event: SSE event type carrying a unified audit event matching the GET /api/v1/audit response schema
glossary.broadcaster: Fan-out component within the SSE connection manager that receives emitted events and forwards them to per-connection goroutines
glossary.cursor: Opaque URL-safe base64-encoded pagination token encoding {ts, id} for keyset pagination, consistent with spec 17
glossary.event_type: Dot-notation string identifying the kind of audit event (e.g., hub.workspace.create)
glossary.event_type_prefix: Query parameter enabling prefix-match filtering on event_type (e.g., hub.workspace matches all workspace events)
glossary.heartbeat: Periodic SSE keepalive frame sent every 30 seconds to prevent stale connection detection
glossary.hub.git.push: Audit event_type emitted when a git push is received by the hub git server
glossary.hub.merge.complete: Audit event_type emitted when a merge completes successfully
glossary.hub.merge.enqueue: Audit event_type emitted when a merge is submitted
glossary.hub.merge.fail: Audit event_type emitted when a merge fails
glossary.hub.patch.create: Audit event_type emitted when a carry-patch is added
glossary.hub.patch.delete: Audit event_type emitted when a carry-patch is removed
glossary.hub.rebuild.complete: Audit event_type emitted when a carry-patch rebuild completes
glossary.hub.rebuild.enqueue: Audit event_type emitted when a carry-patch rebuild is enqueued
glossary.hub.rebuild.fail: Audit event_type emitted when a carry-patch rebuild fails
glossary.hub.secret.create: Audit event_type emitted when a secret is created
glossary.hub.secret.delete: Audit event_type emitted when a secret is deleted
glossary.hub.secret.update: Audit event_type emitted when a secret is updated
glossary.hub.session.force_closed: Audit event_type emitted when an agent session is force-closed
glossary.hub.variable.create: Audit event_type emitted when a variable is created
glossary.hub.variable.delete: Audit event_type emitted when a variable is deleted
glossary.hub.variable.update: Audit event_type emitted when a variable is updated
glossary.hub.workspace.archive: Audit event_type emitted when a workspace is archived
glossary.hub.workspace.create: Audit event_type emitted when a workspace is created
glossary.hub.workspace.delete: Audit event_type emitted when a workspace is deleted
glossary.hub.workspace.reactivate: Audit event_type emitted when a workspace is reactivated
glossary.hub.workspace.sync: Audit event_type emitted when a workspace is synced with upstream
glossary.hub.workspace.update: Audit event_type emitted when a workspace is updated
glossary.hub_audit_events: DuckDB table storing hub-internal audit events, defined in spec 17
glossary.internal/audit/emitter.go: File containing the default Emitter implementation, extended to broadcast to SSE subscribers on emit
glossary.internal/audit/handlers.go: File containing the unified query handler, transcript handler, and SSE handler
glossary.internal/audit/routes.go: File registering audit GET routes including the unified query, transcript, and SSE endpoints
glossary.internal/audit/sse.go: New file containing the SSE connection manager, broadcaster, and heartbeat goroutine
glossary.node_id: Identifier for a specific node within an agent run, used to reconstruct conversation transcripts
glossary.resource_type: The category of resource affected by a hub audit event: workspace, merge, patch, secret, variable, or job
glossary.run_id: Identifier for a specific agent execution run, used to correlate agent audit events and traces
glossary.session.init: Agent trace event type representing session initialization, mapped to the system role in transcripts
glossary.session_id: Identifier for an agent session, populated in agent audit events
glossary.session_outcome: SSE event type carrying agent session outcome data, schema defined in spec 17
glossary.source: Field in unified audit query results distinguishing hub-internal events (hub) from agent-submitted events (agent)
glossary.stale-connection timeout: 60-second hardcoded threshold after which an SSE connection with no reads is closed
glossary.tool.error: Agent trace event type representing a tool error, mapped to the tool_error role in transcripts
glossary.tool.use: Agent trace event type representing a tool invocation, mapped to the tool_use role in transcripts

requirements.title: SSE connection manager and broadcaster implementation

user_story.goal: have a correct and resource-safe SSE connection manager integrated with the Emitter
user_story.benefit: the SSE subsystem handles concurrent connections, backpressure, and cleanup without leaking goroutines or memory

acceptance_criteria.action: implement the SSE connection manager in internal/audit/sse.go with a broadcaster goroutine, per-connection goroutines, a heartbeat goroutine, and a connection registry protected by a mutex or equivalent synchronization
extend the default Emitter implementation in internal/audit/emitter.go so that every successful Emit call also publishes the event to the SSE broadcast channel
read the maximum connection limit from AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS at startup, defaulting to 100 if the variable is absent or unparseable
define the heartbeat interval as a hardcoded constant of 30 seconds and the stale-connection timeout as a hardcoded constant of 60 seconds; these values must not be read from environment variables

edge_cases.action: drop the event and log at debug level rather than blocking the Emitter
edge_cases.return_contract: The event is not delivered to any SSE client; the Emitter returns without blocking
edge_cases.error_condition: the broadcast channel itself is full when the Emitter tries to publish

edge_cases.action: fall back to the default limit of 100 and log a warning
edge_cases.return_contract: The SSE subsystem initializes with the default limit of 100; a warning is logged
edge_cases.error_condition: AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS is set to a non-integer or negative value

edge_cases.action: recover from the panic, log the error, and restart the broadcaster goroutine to prevent total SSE subsystem failure
edge_cases.return_contract: The broadcaster resumes operation; existing SSE connections are unaffected
edge_cases.error_condition: the broadcaster goroutine panics

register GET /api/v1/events on the Echo router with the audit:read permission middleware and the SSE handler

edge_cases.action: panic at startup with a descriptive message rather than registering routes that will crash at request time
edge_cases.return_contract: process panics at startup with a descriptive error message
edge_cases.error_condition: the Store or SSE connection manager is nil at route registration time

correctness_properties.title: Emission does not block or fail mutations
correctness_properties.for_any: hub mutation handler with a non-nil Audit emitter
correctness_properties.invariant: the HTTP response status and body of the mutation are identical whether Emit succeeds, fails, or the Audit field is nil

correctness_properties.title: Cursor round-trip correctness
correctness_properties.for_any: any valid audit query response with has_more=true
correctness_properties.invariant: decoding next_cursor from URL-safe base64 yields a valid JSON object with ts and id fields, and using that cursor in a subsequent GET /api/v1/audit request returns the next page of events without duplicates or gaps

correctness_properties.title: Source field accuracy in unified query
correctness_properties.invariant: events originating from hub_audit_events have source=hub with non-null hub-specific fields and null agent-specific fields; events from agent_audit_events have source=agent with non-null agent-specific fields and null hub-specific fields

correctness_properties.title: SSE heartbeat invariant
correctness_properties.invariant: at least one heartbeat frame is delivered within every 30-second window, ensuring the stale-connection timeout of 60 seconds is never triggered by the heartbeat interval alone

correctness_properties.title: SSE connection cap enforcement
correctness_properties.for_any: any sequence of SSE connection attempts
correctness_properties.invariant: the number of concurrently active SSE connections never exceeds the value of AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS; any connection attempt that would exceed the cap receives HTTP 503

correctness_properties.title: Transcript ordering
correctness_properties.for_any: any transcript response for a given run_id and node_id
correctness_properties.invariant: messages are ordered strictly by ascending timestamp with no reordering or deduplication

correctness_properties.title: Nil emitter safety
correctness_properties.for_any: any handler package with an Audit field set to nil
correctness_properties.invariant: no nil pointer dereference or panic occurs; the handler behaves identically to a handler with no Audit field configured

correctness_properties.title: SSE backpressure: broadcaster never blocks
correctness_properties.for_any: any event emitted when one or more per-client channels are full
correctness_properties.invariant: the Emitter.Emit call returns without blocking regardless of the state of any per-client SSE channel; slow consumers cause event drops, not broadcaster stalls

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/workspaces with workspace creation parameters and a valid API key
validates the request, creates the workspace record in the database, and returns HTTP 201
calls cfg.Audit.Emit with a HubEvent of event_type hub.workspace.create, actor_id from apikit.GetAuthInfo, and metadata containing git_url and branch
writes the HubEvent to hub_audit_events in DuckDB and publishes the event to the SSE broadcast channel
fans out the event to all registered SSE subscriber goroutines
applies workspace and category filters, then writes an audit_event SSE frame to the connected client

execution_paths.title: Unified audit query with cursor pagination

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/audit?source=hub&workspace=my-workspace&limit=50 with a valid bearer token having audit:read scope
validates authentication and audit:read permission via apikit middleware
constructs a UNION ALL SQL query over hub_audit_events and agent_audit_events with source=hub and workspace=my-workspace filters and limit=50
executes the query against DuckDB and returns up to 50 rows ordered by timestamp
encodes the next cursor as URL-safe base64 of {ts, id} from the last result row and sets has_more=true if 50 rows were returned
returns HTTP 200 with JSON body containing events array, next_cursor, and has_more
sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/runs/run-uuid/transcript?node_id=node-uuid with a valid bearer token having audit:read scope
validates authentication, audit:read permission, and presence of node_id query parameter
queries agent_traces for run_id=run-uuid and node_id=node-uuid ordered by timestamp
returns trace rows from DuckDB for the given run and node
maps each trace event type to a conversation role (session.init→system, assistant.message→assistant, tool.use→tool_use, tool.error→tool_error) and builds the messages array
returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {run_id, node_id, messages: [...]}

execution_paths.title: SSE real-time event delivery to dashboard

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/events?workspace=my-workspace using fetch() with ReadableStream and Authorization: Bearer header
validates authentication and audit:read permission; checks that active connection count is below AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS
registers the client with a new per-client buffered channel of 256 events and starts a per-connection goroutine
begins streaming; sends an initial heartbeat frame to confirm the connection is live
triggers a workspace mutation (e.g., archive) via the REST API
calls cfg.Audit.Emit with a HubEvent of event_type hub.workspace.archive
writes the event to hub_audit_events and publishes it to the SSE broadcast channel
fans out the event to all per-connection goroutines
matches the event against the workspace=my-workspace filter and writes an audit_event SSE frame to the dashboard client
receives the SSE frame and updates the live dashboard view

execution_paths.title: End-to-end: agent run ingestion through to unified query

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/audit/ingest with a batch of JSONL agent audit events (spec 17 ingestion endpoint)
validates the payload and writes events to agent_audit_events in DuckDB
triggers a workspace sync mutation via the REST API
calls cfg.Audit.Emit with a HubEvent of event_type hub.workspace.sync
writes the HubEvent to hub_audit_events and broadcasts to SSE subscribers
sends GET /api/v1/audit?since=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z with audit:read scope
executes UNION ALL query over agent_audit_events and hub_audit_events with the since filter
returns merged rows from DuckDB ordered by timestamp
returns HTTP 200 with unified events array containing both agent and hub events, each with the correct source field

error_handling.condition: Emitter.Emit returns an error during any hub mutation handler
error_handling.behavior: log the error at an appropriate level and continue; the mutation HTTP response is unaffected

error_handling.condition: cursor query parameter is present but cannot be base64-decoded or JSON-parsed
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 400 with apikit.WriteAPIError body containing message invalid cursor

error_handling.condition: DuckDB query fails in the unified audit query handler
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 500 with apikit.WriteAPIError body containing a generic error message

error_handling.condition: request to GET /api/v1/audit, GET /api/v1/events, or GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/transcript is unauthenticated
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 401 with standard apikit error body before executing any handler logic

error_handling.condition: authenticated caller lacks audit:read permission scope on any audit endpoint
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 403 with standard apikit error body before executing any handler logic

error_handling.condition: node_id query parameter is missing from GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/transcript
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 400 with apikit.WriteAPIError body containing message node_id is required

error_handling.condition: DuckDB query against agent_traces fails in the transcript handler
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 500 with apikit.WriteAPIError body containing a generic error message

error_handling.condition: active SSE connection count equals or exceeds AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS when a new connection arrives
error_handling.behavior: return HTTP 503 with JSON body {"error": "too many SSE connections"} without upgrading the connection

error_handling.condition: per-client SSE channel of 256 events is full when a new event arrives
error_handling.behavior: drop the oldest event from the channel, enqueue the new event, and log the drop at debug level

error_handling.condition: SSE client disconnects (context cancelled or TCP connection closed)
error_handling.behavior: detect via context cancellation, deregister the client from the broadcaster, and release the per-client goroutine and channel

error_handling.condition: AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS is set to a non-integer or negative value
error_handling.behavior: fall back to the default limit of 100 and log a warning at startup
recover from the panic, log the error, and restart the broadcaster goroutine
